findings.title: `AssignmentSource.queued` default is evaluated once at import time
findings.body: `queued: datetime = timezone.now()` evaluates `timezone.now()` once when the `assignment_source` module is imported rather than when each `AssignmentSource` instance is instantiated. Every `AssignmentSource` created without an explicit `queued` argument will share the process import timestamp. Use ` dataclasses.field(default_factory=timezone.now)` instead.

findings.title: `assignment_source` added to `sync_status_outbound` instead of `sync_assignee_outbound`, and passed to subclass implementations
findings.body: `IssueSyncIntegration.sync_status_outbound` was updated with `assignment_source: AssignmentSource | None = None`, even though status sync never passes `assignment_source`, while `IssueSyncIntegration.sync_assignee_outbound` was not updated. Meanwhile, `src/sentry/integrations/tasks/sync_assignee_outbound.py` (line 60) unconditionally passes `assignment_source=parsed_assignment_source` to `installation.sync_assignee_outbound(...)`. Any `IssueSyncIntegration` subclass whose `sync_assignee_outbound` signature does not accept `assignment_source` or `**kwargs` will raise `TypeError: sync_assignee_outbound() got an unexpected keyword argument 'assignment_source'` on every outbound assignee sync (even when `assignment_source` is `None`). Since `installation.should_sync` already checks `parsed_assignment_source` before calling `sync_assignee_outbound`, either avoid passing `assignment_source` into `installation.sync_assignee_outbound` or update `sync_assignee_outbound` and all concrete implementations rather than `sync_status_outbound`.
